describe: read a sensor, like temperature, light or distance
guide: Never choose a pin. If the message does not say which pin, ask. Pins 0 and 1 are the USB connection; never use them for a part.

Ask which sensor they have if they have not said -- the code depends on the exact part. Never invent a part number or pinout. An analog sensor is read with analogRead(A0); print readings with Serial.println.
